blocks.title: Sort into: Rhymes with cake / Does not rhyme

blocks.answer: Rhymes with cake: bake; make; shake; lake. Does not rhyme: cook; loaf

questions.q: Say the couplet by heart with a partner
write a rhyming couplet about baking
questions.a: For example: I rolled the dough upon the tray, then baked some bread for us today.
questions.model: Labelled model: Line 1 (ends in tray): I rolled the dough upon the tray, | Line 2 (ends in today): then baked some bread for us today.

questions.a: For example: The oven glowed so warm and red, and out came our delicious bread.
